Subject: SOW addendum & invoice cadence

Hi Evelyn,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team is comfortable moving forward but we need a small addendum to the Order Form / SOW before our procurement team can cut the PO. Two items to confirm: (1) We need an additional 2,000 GPU hours/month for Q4 (phased ramp starting 2026-11-01), and (2) we prefer monthly invoicing instead of Redwood's standard quarterly cadence due to our internal budget cycles.

Can your legal/procurement review the attached PO and propose redlines to the Order Form and exhibit that capture the phased ramp and monthly billing? Also need to understand any proration implications if we ramp mid-month and whether committed minimums still apply. Our procurement deadline is Oct 8 to include this in our Q4 budget.

Attaching: BW_PO_5482.pdf

Best,
Angela Park
Head of Cloud Procurement
BrightWave Health

Internal plan: Laura (legal) + Karthik (sales/finance) will draft redlines to the Order Form and an Exhibit A that outlines the ramp schedule and monthly invoicing language. I'll coordinate on implementation timeline and share a mutual action plan by EOD tomorrow (9/30).

- Confirm whether BrightWave wants monthly invoices with Net 30 terms or monthly with net-45 (we can do either but need explicit cadence).
- Are there internal sign-off steps beyond procurement (e.g., security/legal review) that could affect timing?

We aim to return a redline set for your review by 10/4 so you can route to procurement before 10/8.

Thanks — Evelyn

Subject: Re: SOW addendum & invoice cadence — proposed redlines

Evelyn / Karthik — drafting notes below and attaching redlines (redlines_orderform_v1.docx). Please treat as internal draft until I hear back from Angela on the billing cadence.

Summary of redline approach (high level):
- Ramp and capacity: Add Exhibit A section "Phased Capacity Ramp" with table showing Nov: +500 GPU hrs, Dec: +1,000, Jan: +500 to reach 2,000/month. Identify the effective start date for billing at each step and call out prorated charges for partial-month ramps.
- Billing cadence: Replace the Order Form language referencing "quarterly invoices" with a new clause in Section 3.2: "Customer shall be invoiced monthly in arrears. Invoices are due Net 30 unless otherwise agreed in writing." We will allow Net 45 as an alternative but that requires a contract amendment sign-off.
- Committed minimums: Preserve the committed minimum for the initial term and ensure ramped hours do not reduce that minimum without a signed amendment.
- Early termination / rollback protection: Propose a 60-day notification window and pro rata refunds for overpayments only in limited circumstances (fraud/force majeure). BrightWave requested waiver language — we should avoid full waiver of termination fees.
- Data residency flag: There's a side note in Section 7 about data locality; security needs to confirm if BrightWave's environment will require additional exhibits. I'm looping in the security review ticket internally (INF-9123).

Open questions for BrightWave (please confirm):
1) Which invoice cadence do you prefer (Net 30 monthly, Net 45 monthly, or stick with quarterly)?
2) Would BrightWave accept the proposed 60-day notification for termination versus a full waiver?
3) Can Procurement provide an example invoice schedule so we can mirror numbering/proration in our billing system?

Attaching: redlines_orderform_v1.docx

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com
